newsitem.title: USA: United Technologies sets 2-for-1 stock split.
newsitem.headline: United Technologies sets 2-for-1 stock split.

text.p: United Technologies Corp. Monday announced a two-for-one stock split as of Dec. 10, and doubled the outstanding authorisation for its stock repurchase programme.
A stock dividend will be distributed to shareholders of record as of Nov. 22.

United Technologies also declared regular quarterly dividends of 55 cents on the pre-split common shares, and of $1.20 a share on the convertible preferred stock held under the company's Employee Stock Ownership Plan.
Hartford, Conn.-based United Technologies provides high technology products and support services to the building systems, automotive, and aerospace industries.
United Technologies' stock closed Friday at $120.25 on the New York Stock Exchange.
